source_snippet: 13.118.010 Definitions. As used in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires: "County resident" refers to any individual whose primary and legal place of residence is located within the geographical boundaries of Storey County. Residency may be demonstrated through documentation such as a valid driver’s license or state ID with a Storey County address, a current utility bill, lease or mortgage agreement, voter registration, or other official documents showing name and address within the Storey County. “Immediate Family” means the Storey County Resident’s spouse or domestic partner, parents, children (including stepchildren and legally adopted children), siblings, grandparents, and grandchildren, whether related by blood, marriage, or legal adoption. source_snippet: 4. Staff summary: This resolution is in recognition of the lifesaving efforts made by Storey County Fire District Firefighter Jesse Richardson. On July 26th Jesse responded along with his partner Charlie Bowman to a fire on Lousetown Road with a report of a victim trapped. While Charlie attempted access to the interior of the structure, Jesse carried a 24’ ladder around to the C side of the structure locating the victim on the balcony. He placed the ladder and even utilized a rock to stabilize it due to the angle. He then ascended the ladder and assisted the resident over the railing and down to safety. Without his efforts, the outcome could have been fatal.

source_snippet: From the PershingCountyNV.gov homepage click the "Agendas & Minutes" Quicklink button, then look for the second category on the Agendas & Minutes Page labeled "Board of Commissioners Meeting Packets". Packets will be organized under this category by year, labeled by date of the meeting, and sorted by meeting date. From the PershingCountyNV.gov homepage, scroll down to the "Upcoming Events" Calendar. If the meeting is one of the next three events on the calendar, it will appear in the list to the right of the calendar. Otherwise, you can click on the date of the meeting to see all events for that day, then click on the meeting event. The event will appear with links to both the meeting's agenda and the packet. As a final note, the agenda will usually be available before the packet as the meeting packet takes more time to prepare. If there are not links available for the meeting packet,...
